_note: 學習路徑內容建置第17批 #6／6：相關連接詞與主詞動詞一致（eng.t_adv.conj.correlative，學測級／高階）。成對連接詞：both A and B（複數動詞）、either A or B、neither A nor B、not only A but also B。both…and 一律複數動詞；either/neither/not only…but also 的動詞依『就近原則』配靠近的（第二個）主詞；連接的兩部分要結構對等。誘答以『both…and 誤用單數／就近原則配錯主詞／連接詞配對錯（both 配 or）』鎖唯一正解；就近原則的理由只點明會考/學測所教的規則、不誣指口語變體。皆標準英語，經對抗式英語母語複核。音檔 edge-tts 童聲（prefix corr_）。

units.title_zh: 相關連接詞與主詞動詞一致（both…and／either…or／neither…nor／not only…but also）
units.can_do: 我能用成對的相關連接詞連接對等的部分：both…and（複數動詞）、either…or、neither…nor、not only…but also，並知道 either/neither/not only…but also 的動詞依就近原則配靠近的主詞。
units.situation_group: 相關連接詞與主詞動詞一致
units.subject: eng

claims.text: 'both ... and ...' joins two subjects and takes a plural verb: 'Both Tom and Jerry are here.'
claims.verification_ref: both…and 連接主詞用複數動詞；Both Tom and Jerry are here；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: With 'either ... or ...' and 'neither ... nor ...', the verb agrees with the nearer (second) subject (the proximity rule): 'Neither the players nor the coach is here.'
claims.verification_ref: either…or / neither…nor 動詞依就近原則配第二個主詞；Neither the players nor the coach is；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: 'not only ... but also ...' also follows the proximity rule for verb agreement: 'Not only the players but also the coach was happy.'
claims.verification_ref: not only…but also 動詞依就近原則；Not only the players but also the coach was happy；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

claims.text: Each correlative conjunction has a fixed partner: both…and, either…or, neither…nor, not only…but also; they join parallel (same-kind) structures.
claims.verification_ref: 成對連接詞固定搭配、連接對等結構；both…and / either…or / neither…nor / not only…but also；對抗式英語母語 reviewer 複核

teach.body: Correlative conjunctions come in pairs and join two equal parts. When 'both A and B' joins two subjects, the verb is plural: Both my brother and I like soccer.
teach.zh_hint: 相關連接詞成對出現，連接兩個對等的部分。both A and B（A 和 B 兩者都）連接兩個主詞時，動詞一律用複數：Both my brother and I like soccer.（我哥和我都喜歡足球。）

teach.body: Both Tom and Mary are good at singing.
teach.zh_hint: Tom 和 Mary 都很會唱歌。both…and 用複數動詞 are。

teach.body: With either A or B and neither A nor B, the verb agrees with the subject that is nearer to it (the 'proximity rule'). Neither the players nor the coach is here. (The verb matches 'the coach', so it is 'is'.)
teach.zh_hint: either A or B（不是 A 就是 B）、neither A nor B（A、B 都不）：動詞跟「靠近的那個主詞」一致（就近原則）。Neither the players nor the coach is here.（球員和教練都不在——動詞配 the coach，用 is。）

teach.body: Either the cups or the plate is dirty.
teach.zh_hint: 不是那些杯子就是那個盤子髒了——動詞配靠近的 the plate 用 is。

teach.body: not only A but also B also uses the proximity rule, so the verb agrees with B. Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised. (The verb matches 'the teacher'.) Remember to keep each pair together, and to join two parts that have the same structure.
teach.zh_hint: not only A but also B（不但 A 而且 B）也用就近原則，動詞配 B。Not only the students but also the teacher was surprised.（不只學生，連老師也很驚訝——動詞配 the teacher。）注意每對連接詞都要固定搭配，連接的兩部分也要結構對等。

teach.body: Not only my friends but also my sister likes this song.
teach.zh_hint: 不只我朋友，連我妹也喜歡這首歌——動詞配 my sister 用 likes。

practice.stem: 選正確：Both my father and my mother ____ teachers.（我爸和我媽都是老師）

distractor_rationales.is: both…and 連接兩個主詞，動詞一律用複數 are。
distractor_rationales.was: 兩個人、且是現在，用 are，不用過去式 was。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的 are，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: both…and 用複數動詞：Both… and… are teachers。

practice.stem: 選正確：Neither the players nor the coach ____ satisfied with the result.（球員和教練都不滿意這個結果）

distractor_rationales.are: neither…nor 依就近原則，動詞配靠近的 the coach（單數）用 is。
distractor_rationales.were: 現在時間用 is，不用過去式 were。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的 is，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: neither…nor 就近配 the coach（單數）：is。

practice.stem: 選正確：Either the teacher or the students ____ going to clean the room.（不是老師就是學生要打掃教室）

distractor_rationales.is: either…or 依就近原則，動詞配靠近的 the students（複數）用 are。
distractor_rationales.was: 現在時間用 are，不用過去式 was。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的 are，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: either…or 就近配 the students（複數）：are。

practice.stem: 選正確：Not only the dancers but also the singer ____ tired after the show.（不只舞者，連歌手在表演後也累了）

distractor_rationales.were: not only…but also 依就近原則，動詞配靠近的 the singer（單數）用 was。
distractor_rationales.are: 句子講表演後（過去），用過去式 was，不用現在式 are。
distractor_rationales.be: 需要有時態的 was，不是原形 be。

practice.feedback: not only…but also 就近配 the singer（單數、過去）：was。

practice.stem: 選正確：____ my parents or my uncle is coming to the party.（不是我爸媽就是我叔叔要來派對）

distractor_rationales.Both: both 固定搭配 and，不搭配 or。
distractor_rationales.Neither: neither 固定搭配 nor，不搭配 or；且 neither 是『兩者都不』，與句意不符。
distractor_rationales.Not only: not only 固定搭配 but also，不搭配 or。

practice.feedback: 搭配 or 的是 either…or：Either… or…。

practice.stem: 聽音檔，把整句寫下來（聽寫）。
practice.answer: Both my mother and my father work in a hospital.
practice.feedback: 對照答案自評：both…and 連接兩個主詞（my mother and my father）、動詞用複數 work 有沒有寫對、句點有沒有漏。

units.selfeval_note: 翻看答案自己判斷（不自動判讀）；選完進入 SRS 間隔複習。

shadowing.note: 跟著讀＋語調模仿：播音檔→跟著讀→自評（不自動判發音）。成對連接詞 both/and、neither/nor 稍微重讀、句尾下收。

lines.text: Both my mother and my father enjoy cooking.
lines.intonation: both…and 連接兩個主詞、Both my mother and my father 起、enjoy cooking 句尾下收

lines.text: Neither the teacher nor the students were late.
lines.intonation: Neither…nor 稍重讀、were late 句尾下收（動詞配 students 用 were）
